c.title: $5,200 / 4br - Furnished 4-Bedroom House in Dunbar (Dunbar)
c.description:
This spacious 4-bedroom house is located in the highly desirable Dunbar neighbourhood on King Edward Avenue, making it an excellent choice for a group of UBC students or working professionals.

Rent: $5,200/month + utilities (utilities average approximately $50/person/month)
Available: Immediately
Lease Term: Minimum 9 months

Features
- Excellent location - Easy 20-minute bus ride to UBC via Bus 25, with nearby access to Bus 2 and Bus 7; convenient transit to Downtown Vancouver; walking distance to Dunbar Village amenities (including Stong's Market, banks, Shoppers Drug Mart, Cafés, restaurants, and other everyday conveniences)
- 4 spacious, fully furnished bedrooms (including bed frame, mattress, desk, chair, closet/storage space)
- Fully equipped kitchen with refrigerator, stove, and microwave
- On-site laundry
- High-speed Internet included
- Street parking available

House Rules
- No pets, no smoking/vaping, no drugs or partying
- Looking for clean, respectful tenants who will help maintain a quiet living environment

If you're interested, please send us a message introducing your group, including: Your names, school/program, desired move-in date, a little about your group.

We'd be happy to arrange a viewing!
